institution: KSCSTE - National Transportation Planning and Research Centre (NATPAC)
problem_solved: Fragmented, inefficient manual data collection and the lack of centralized spatial analysis for critical road assets, traffic volumes, and crash statistics.
description: A comprehensive, GIS-based web and mobile ecosystem designed for strategic road asset management. KTDMS integrates a Road Asset Management System (RAMS) built on a service-oriented architecture (SOA). Field surveyors use custom Android applications to log timestamped traffic volumes, parking data, and road inventory. This data syncs instantly to a centralized web platform equipped with analytical modules to assess vehicle/pedestrian volumes and evaluate traffic signal warrants.
applications:
• State transport and public works departments (PWD) for highway asset maintenance

• Municipal corporations and Smart City urban planning boards

• Traffic police and road safety authorities for crash mapping and mitigation

• CivicTech consulting and urban infrastructure development agencies
